community.name: Poor Clares of Brigid's Hill
community.tagline: Contemplative nuns living the Gospel in poverty, enclosure and joy, and praying for the world day and night.

contact.phoneHours: The extern sisters answer 10 am to 12 pm and 2 pm to 4 pm

home.headline: Hidden with Christ in God, for the sake of the world
home.lede: Fourteen Poor Clare nuns praying the Divine Office and keeping watch before the Blessed Sacrament.
welcome: Our chapel is open every day for Mass and adoration. Our prayer is for you: send us your intentions and we will carry them before the Lord.
This website is a made-up example of the free monastery site template. Every name and detail here is invented.

intro: Saint Clare founded our order in Assisi in 1212 to live the Gospel as Saint Francis did, in poverty and joy. Our monastery was founded in 1928 by five sisters.
charism: We are contemplative nuns in papal enclosure. Our life is given to prayer: the Divine Office, the Eucharist, adoration and silence, lived in sisterly love. We own nothing and live on what Providence sends.
dailyLife: We rise at midnight for Matins, then sleep again until Lauds. The day is ordered by the Office, Mass, work in the altar bread department and the garden, study and recreation together.

vocations.lede: We welcome Catholic women who desire to give their whole life to God in prayer, poverty and enclosure.
requirements: In good health, able to keep the night Office and the fasts of the Rule
Free of debts and family obligations

stages.name: Correspondence and a visit
stages.text: Write to the vocation directress, then visit the parlour and spend time with the community.

stages.name: Aspirancy
stages.text: Live inside the enclosure to share the life before asking to enter.

stages.name: Postulancy
stages.text: Learn the life, the chant and the customs of the monastery.

stages.name: Novitiate
stages.text: Receive the habit and a new name, and study the Rule of Saint Clare.

stages.name: Temporary vows
stages.text: Vows of obedience, poverty, chastity and enclosure, renewed until solemn profession.

stages.name: Solemn vows
stages.text: Lifelong consecration as a Poor Clare in this monastery.

retreats.name: Discernment weekend
retreats.text: For women 18 to 35. Stay in the guest quarters, pray with the community and talk with the sisters in the parlour.

faq.q: Will I ever see my family again?
faq.a: Yes. Families visit in the parlour, and the community is glad to welcome them.
The part of the monastery reserved to the nuns, so that our life can be given wholly to prayer.
No. Come as you are; Providence provides.

giving.lede: By our vow of poverty we own nothing and live on alms. Every gift is received with gratitude and remembered in prayer.
